goal: Build a CLI tool that calculates true freelancer profitability by analyzing income, expenses, and hours to determine effective hourly rate, tax estimates, and project margins.
acceptance_criteria: Tool reads CSV with columns: date, type, category, amount, hours, project
Tool calculates net profit, effective hourly rate (profit/hours), and tax estimate (25% of net)
Tool outputs a formatted table showing project-wise breakdown and overall summary
Tool handles missing columns gracefully with warnings and skips invalid rows
